name: taro cold foam boba
taste: creamy taro with cold foam on top. sweet, nutty, earthy. the foam is cold and the tea underneath is warm-cool. brown sugar jelly at the bottom catching on the straw.
texture: thick and smooth. the foam layer is light and airy, dissolves on contact. the jelly is chewy — catches between teeth in the best way.
description: freshly made taro with cold foam and taro powder. gift-only. made by mish after a 20-minute hostage negotiation on the apartment floor.
